Our Story

Building Confidence, One Session At A Time

Starting out in 2016, Gold & Gray Soccer Academy has grown into one of Scotland's premier football coaching providers — founded by David Gold and Ross Gray, both UEFA licensed coaches, on a cutting-edge, structured programme that delivers the core skills of football to any child, at any age or stage of the game.

In June 2026, Gold & Gray acquired the Aberdeen academy, bringing that same nationally-trusted programme to families across the city. "We were really impressed with the job the previous owner and his staff did up here," said David Gold. "The big thing was the staff and coaches he has on-board" — the same experienced local team continues to deliver every session today, now backed by a UEFA-licensed academy trusted since 2016.

Founded by David Gold & Ross Gray — UEFA Licensed Coaches

David Gold is currently co-manager of Arbroath FC; Ross Gray plays for Bonnyrigg Rose. Both bring senior and professional football experience directly into every Gold & Gray session.

Co-founder Ross Gray on what Gold & Gray brings to Aberdeen

The coaching is not age specific. It is very player specific.
— David Gold, Gold & Gray Soccer Academy

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

What should my child wear?

Comfortable sportswear, shin pads, and appropriate footwear for the surface (astroturf trainers or football boots). Please bring a water bottle too.

What happens if it rains?

Sessions run in all weather unless conditions are unsafe. If a session is cancelled due to extreme weather, we will notify you in advance and offer a make-up session.

Can I change sessions?

Yes! You can switch between available sessions at any time by contacting us or through your parent portal. Subject to availability.

What age groups do you cater for?

We offer classes for children of all ages, from toddlers through to teens. Check the programmes above to find the right group for your child.

Is there a trial session available?

Yes — most classes offer a trial session so your child can experience our coaching before committing. The trial price (if any) is shown on the class page when you book. Tap "Book a Trial" to get started.
